# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V0015 source_not_utf8"
description: "The source file is not UTF-8."
---

An error from the `lex` phase. `sakura explain V0015` prints this explanation offline.

The source file is not UTF-8. Sakura Lang source is UTF-8 text; the message names the first
invalid byte and its offset, where the span points. The rest of that file is not checked until
its encoding is fixed (its other diagnostics would be about text it does not hold); the other
files are checked as usual. Save the file as UTF-8: a Latin-1 `é` is the byte 0xE9, which UTF-8
writes as 0xC3 0xA9. `sakura fmt` and edits leave such a file untouched.

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V0015_source_not_utf8/`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/V0015_source_not_utf8/), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:
